events.title: James Alexander's Soul Sundays
events.location: Currumbin Beach Vikings Surf Life Saving Club, Currumbin
events.description: A recurring Sunday session featuring soul music by James Alexander, held at the Currumbin Beach Vikings Surf Life Saving Club. Expect a relaxed, atmospheric live music experience by the beach.

events.title: After Glow – Collage Workshop with Meli Axford and Trish Tait
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A creative collage workshop led by artists Meli Axford and Trish Tait, offering a hands-on opportunity to explore collage techniques at HOTA, Home of the Arts.

events.title: Koi Sunset Sessions
events.description: A recurring evening social event at Koi Dining in Broadbeach, offering a relaxed atmosphere to enjoy sunsets. Expect background music and drinks in a popular Gold Coast venue.

events.title: Pat Tierney Concert
events.description: A live concert featuring Australian folk/blues artist Pat Tierney, known for his roots-infused music. Expect an intimate performance in the Gold Coast metro area.

events.title: Mudgeeraba Agricultural Show
events.description: A classic community agricultural show weekend featuring animals, local competitions, food stalls, entertainment, and family activities. A chance to experience local Gold Coast culture.

events.title: PNAU Concert
events.description: A live concert by Australian electronic music trio PNAU, known for their dance-pop and indie electronic tracks. Expect a high-energy performance at TRI in the Gold Coast.
